entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, are you grateful[n]for what I do for you?
entries.uk: Агов, ти вдячний[n]за те, що я для тебе роблю?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If so, you really should[n]help out some more.
entries.uk: Якщо так, то варто б[n]допомагати більше.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, there are some[n]things I want to talk[n]to you about. Come home.
entries.uk: Хай там як, мені треба[n]з тобою дещо обговорити.[n]Іди додому.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Something happen to you? Don't[n]be afraid to come back, OK?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Thought so. Well, I'll[n]be waiting for you.
entries.uk: Так я й думав. Ну,[n]чекаю на тебе.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What are you going to do? Will you[n]accept the chief's invitation?
